deviations.plan: 3.3: "Claim plan: atomic claims bound to span ids from a structured envelope; unbound dropped [Risk R-11]."
deviations.applied: under D-19 extractive mode the claim unit is one verbatim whole sentence of every cited span (a sentences-v2 sentence of the document's section text lying wholly inside the span, at most max_sentence_chars), not a decomposed atomic claim: a sub-sentence cut can drop a qualification or a negation (spec conflict 32), so binding refuses it (not_verbatim), and refuses a span-edge fragment of a longer document sentence too (partial_sentence; rule resolver-bundle-sentence-v2, spec 18.10 H1). A compound sentence is one claim with one future verdict. Atomic decomposition needs a generator that writes claims (Phase 5, D-12) and per-claim V1.3 entailment (Phase 4)
